corrections.text: The article quotes Cognition as saying its multi-model approach gives companies "frontier-level performance for 60% less." The cited source, The Next Web, does not place this phrase in quotation marks; it is The Next Web's own paraphrase of Cognition's claim, not a direct quotation. The underlying 60%-less claim is accurately sourced.

The article quotes Karan Ahuja as using Claude Duet to schedule interviews and "even ship code," presenting the latter phrase as verbatim. The cited source, SiliconANGLE, does not quote this phrase; it is SiliconANGLE's own narration describing Ahuja's usage, not a direct quotation from Ahuja. The underlying fact is accurately sourced.

The article names Anthropic in its lead and devotes a dedicated background paragraph and an implications-section comparison to Claude Duet, but omits the one-sentence disclosure that the Herald's contributor model is built by Anthropic, as required by editorial policy when an Anthropic product receives coverage beyond an incidental mention.
